mapper.insert: insert into REPORT ( REPORT_INDEX, REPORT_TOID, REPORT_FROMID, REPORT_CON, REPORT_TYPE, REPORT_DATE, REPORT_STATUS ) values ( REPORT_NUM_SEQ.nextval, #{toId}, #{fromId}, #{reportContent}, #{reportType}, sysdate, 'N' )
mapper.select: select REPORT_INDEX, REPORT_TOID,REPORT_FROMID,REPORT_CON,REPORT_TYPE, REPORT_DATE,REPORT_PRODATE,REPORT_STATUS from report where REPORT_INDEX=#{reportId}
select REPORT_INDEX,REPORT_TOID,REPORT_FROMID,REPORT_CON,REPORT_TYPE, REPORT_DATE,REPORT_PRODATE,REPORT_STATUS from report order by REPORT_INDEX desc
select REPORT_INDEX,REPORT_TOID,REPORT_FROMID,REPORT_CON,REPORT_TYPE, REPORT_DATE,REPORT_PRODATE,REPORT_STATUS from report where REPORT_TOID = #{toId} order by REPORT_INDEX desc
